message.reasoning: No abstract present — required deliverable. Word count seems fine. No figures. References: 4, some relevant. VW scandal misdescribed (defeat devices were emissions, not crash-safety tests — technical error). "electric vehicles" wrong too. 1% of 5000 = 50, not 500 — calculation error. No abstract → structure issue. Ethical issues identified, stakeholders identified, org context yes. C1: 8. C2: arguments both sides, conclusion but stakeholder-specific decision recommendations limited → 8. C3: logical, conclusion supported → 8. C4: references + quantitative (1% calc, wrong) + case studies → 8? Errors reduce; 7? Levels only 8/6... whole number within range, can pick 7. C4: 7. C5: no abstract, no visuals, typos ("DICUSSION", "erosion ofprofessional"), broken references → 5? Fluent mostly, few references, no visuals → 5.
